cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'd love to lend you my umbrella. How long is the proposed loan?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. An open-ended duration. Do you have a guarantor?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Urgency noted. Please sign without dripping on the terms.

mechanism: A assumes approving authority over an intimate or urgent favor and converts B replies into terms, documentation and staged approval rather than immediate fulfillment.
confusable: Generic stalling is confusable: each new personal need must actually become a more specified request within A approval procedure.
comparison: Wedding reassurance becomes a classified hug request; rainy umbrella becomes duration, guarantee and signature terms.
seedUse: Read both exact cards and all four canonical seeds. Preserve B simpler emotional need and urgent physical need; authority should govern the process rather than a separate rank speech.
